candidate_selection_rule: For EVERY one of the six previously Q-repeatable scientific names, inspect the whole fixed 437 package catalog and select ALL original source study IDs not present in the 63 old DOI/study-ID frame with one original source study ID and one DOI, exact GPS or GNSS sensor metadata, exact sole license CC0 1.0 Universal, >=10 metadata animals, >=10,000 metadata locations, unambiguous unique scientific-name registry, and no duplicate original source-study ID. Do not select on source title, q, site, latitude, scientific interest, anticipated GPS cadence, or new provider file metadata.
source_selection_caveat: The six target taxa were selected because earlier source-native results were seen, and the quota/target is POST-OUTCOME. Source identities within those taxa are selected only from original pre-existing public metadata, before any NEW GPS outcomes. Not prospective target taxon validation or world-random species.
privacy: Any Homo sapiens entry is permanent no-contact HOLD; do not access source files/GPS. Never publish animal IDs, exact timestamps, tracks, coordinates or individual estimates.
interpretation: Passing metadata selection is NOT sufficient for independent field population, wild/non-managed status, original GPS cadence, q measurability or statistically independent source replication.
